limitations: Only observed straight metric tapped holes and their attached ThreadDepth bindings are supported.
Actual attached-thread flags/extents are used even when the input relied on default full-length behavior.
HoleDiameter is a stored model parameter, not assumed to be the thread nominal diameter.
Native attached-thread names can be empty; no runtime display name is invented.
Secondary proxy lists are parsed as counted references, with their meanings still unresolved.
Other tap types, families, compound selections and complete helical geometry regeneration remain unsupported.
